author: Mark Twain
title: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer, Complete

llm_analysis.summary: Tom Sawyer is a young boy who loves playing games and helping his friends. He learns to "whitewash" a fence, wins a contest, and becomes the Model Boy of the village. Later, he meets a new girl named Becky and falls in love with her. He decides to become a pirate and runs away to join them.
